Instruction: Generate code that performs a 3D DC inversion of a dipole-dipole array using the SimPEG library. The model should consist of two spheres, one conductive and the other resistive, compared to the background. The inversion should be restrained to the Core Mesh using an Active Cells mapping combined with an exponential mapping to invert in log conductivity space. The code should also include the creation of a synthetic Dipole-Dipole Survey and a Tikhonov Inversion. Finally, the code should generate a plot of the ground truth and the inverted model, both vertically and horizontally.

```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from discretize import TensorMesh
from SimPEG import maps, data, data_misfit, regularization, optimization, inverse_problem, inversion, directives
from SimPEG.electromagnetics.static import resistivity as dc
from SimPEG.utils import mkvc

# Mesh parameters
cs, ncx, ncy, ncz = 5.0, 40, 40, 20
npad = 8
hx = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncx), (cs, npad, 1.3)]
hy = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncy), (cs, npad, 1.3)]
hz = [(cs, npad, -1.3), (cs, ncz)]
mesh = TensorMesh([hx, hy, hz], x0="CCC")

# Model parameters
background_conductivity = 1e-2  # S/m
sphere1_center = np.array([0, -30, -40])
sphere1_radius = 12
sphere1_conductivity = 1e-1  # conductive sphere

sphere2_center = np.array([0, 30, -40])
sphere2_radius = 12
sphere2_conductivity = 1e-3  # resistive sphere

# Model definition
model = background_conductivity * np.ones(mesh.nC)
xyz = mesh.gridCC

r1 = np.linalg.norm(xyz - sphere1_center, axis=1)
r2 = np.linalg.norm(xyz - sphere2_center, axis=1)
model[r1 < sphere1_radius] = sphere1_conductivity
model[r2 < sphere2_radius] = sphere2_conductivity

# Define core region (active cells)
core_z = mesh.vectorCCz < 0
core_x = np.logical_and(mesh.vectorCCx > -80, mesh.vectorCCx < 80)
core_y = np.logical_and(mesh.vectorCCy > -80, mesh.vectorCCy < 80)
active = np.outer(np.outer(core_x, core_y), core_z).reshape(mesh.vnC, order="F").ravel()

# Mapping: active cells + expMap (log conductivity)
act_map = maps.InjectActiveCells(mesh, active, np.log(background_conductivity))
exp_map = maps.ExpMap()
mapping = exp_map * act_map

# Survey geometry (Dipole-Dipole)
n_electrodes = 24
xmin, xmax = -60, 60
ymin, ymax = -60, 60
z_electrodes = 0.0

x_electrodes = np.linspace(xmin, xmax, n_electrodes)
y_electrodes = np.linspace(ymin, ymax, n_electrodes)
electrodes = np.c_[x_electrodes, np.zeros_like(x_electrodes), np.ones_like(x_electrodes)*z_electrodes]

source_list = []
for i in range(n_electrodes - 3):
    A = electrodes[i]
    B = electrodes[i+1]
    for j in range(i+2, n_electrodes-1):
        M = electrodes[j]
        N = electrodes[j+1]
        src = dc.sources.Dipole([dc.receivers.Dipole(M, N)], A, B)
        source_list.append(src)

survey = dc.survey.Survey(source_list)

# Simulation
simulation = dc.simulation.Simulation3DNodal(
    mesh, survey=survey, sigmaMap=mapping, solver=dc.utils.SolverLU
)

# Synthetic data
sigma_true = np.log(model[active])
d_true = simulation.dpred(sigma_true)
std = 0.03
noise = std * np.abs(d_true) * np.random.randn(*d_true.shape)
d_obs = d_true + noise

data_obj = data.Data(survey, dobs=d_obs, standard_deviation=std * np.abs(d_obs) + 1e-5)

# Inversion setup
dmis = data_misfit.L2DataMisfit(simulation=simulation, data=data_obj)
reg = regularization.Simple(mesh, indActive=active)
opt = optimization.InexactGaussNewton(maxIter=15)
inv_prob = inverse_problem.BaseInvProblem(dmis, reg, opt)
betaest = directives.BetaEstimate_ByEig(beta0_ratio=1e0)
beta_schedule = directives.BetaSchedule(coolingFactor=2, coolingRate=2)
target = directives.TargetMisfit()
save_every = directives.SaveEveryIteration()
inv = inversion.BaseInversion(
    inv_prob, directiveList=[betaest, beta_schedule, target, save_every]
)

# Initial model
m0 = np.log(np.ones(active.sum()) * background_conductivity)

# Run inversion
recovered_model = inv.run(m0)

# Plotting
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))

# Vertical cross-section (Y=0)
y_ind = np.argmin(np.abs(mesh.vectorCCy))
slice_ind = np.where((xyz[:,1] == mesh.vectorCCy[y_ind]) & active)[0]
model_2d = np.full(mesh.vnC[0:2], np.nan)
model_2d[:,:] = np.nan
for ix in range(mesh.vnC[0]):
    for iz in range(mesh.vnC[2]):
        ind = mesh.ravel_index((ix, y_ind, iz), order='F')
        if active[ind]:
            model_2d[ix, iz] = model[ind]
im0 = axes[0,0].imshow(
    np.log10(model_2d.T),
    extent=[mesh.vectorCCx[0], mesh.vectorCCx[-1], mesh.vectorCCz[0], mesh.vectorCCz[-1]],
    origin='lower', aspect='auto', cmap='viridis'
)
axes[0,0].set_title('True Model (Vertical Y=0)')
axes[0,0].set_xlabel('x (m)')
axes[0,0].set_ylabel('z (m)')
plt.colorbar(im0, ax=axes[0,0], label='log10 Conductivity (S/m)')

recovered_full = np.ones(mesh.nC) * np.log(background_conductivity)
recovered_full[active] = recovered_model
recovered_2d = np.full(mesh.vnC[0:2], np.nan)
for ix in range(mesh.vnC[0]):
    for iz in range(mesh.vnC[2]):
        ind = mesh.ravel_index((ix, y_ind, iz), order='F')
        if active[ind]:
            recovered_2d[ix, iz] = np.exp(recovered_full[ind])
im1 = axes[0,1].imshow(
    np.log10(recovered_2d.T),
    extent=[mesh.vectorCCx[0], mesh.vectorCCx[-1], mesh.vectorCCz[0], mesh.vectorCCz[-1]],
    origin='lower', aspect='auto', cmap='viridis'
)
axes[0,1].set_title('Inverted Model (Vertical Y=0)')
axes[0,1].set_xlabel('x (m)')
axes[0,1].set_ylabel('z (m)')
plt.colorbar(im1, ax=axes[0,1], label='log10 Conductivity (S/m)')

# Horizontal slice (z = -40)
z_ind = np.argmin(np.abs(mesh.vectorCCz + 40))
model_h = np.full(mesh.vnC[0:2], np.nan)
for ix in range(mesh.vnC[0]):
    for iy in range(mesh.vnC[1]):
        ind = mesh.ravel_index((ix, iy, z_ind), order='F')
        if active[ind]:
            model_h[ix, iy] = model[ind]
im2 = axes[1,0].imshow(
    np.log10(model_h.T),
    extent=[mesh.vectorCCx[0], mesh.vectorCCx[-1], mesh.vectorCCy[0], mesh.vectorCCy[-1]],
    origin='lower', aspect='auto', cmap='viridis'
)
axes[1,0].set_title('True Model (Horizontal z=-40m)')
axes[1,0].set_xlabel('x (m)')
axes[1,0].set_ylabel('y (m)')
plt.colorbar(im2, ax=axes[1,0], label='log10 Conductivity (S/m)')

recovered_h = np.full(mesh.vnC[0:2], np.nan)
for ix in range(mesh.vnC[0]):
    for iy in range(mesh.vnC[1]):
        ind = mesh.ravel_index((ix, iy, z_ind), order='F')
        if active[ind]:
            recovered_h[ix, iy] = np.exp(recovered_full[ind])
im3 = axes[1,1].imshow(
    np.log10(recovered_h.T),
    extent=[mesh.vectorCCx[0], mesh.vectorCCx[-1], mesh.vectorCCy[0], mesh.vectorCCy[-1]],
    origin='lower', aspect='auto', cmap='viridis'
)
axes[1,1].set_title('Inverted Model (Horizontal z=-40m)')
axes[1,1].set_xlabel('x (m)')
axes[1,1].set_ylabel('y (m)')
plt.colorbar(im3, ax=axes[1,1], label='log10 Conductivity (S/m)')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
